title: [MouseWithoutBorders] Fix InputInjector startup probe and fall back to SendInput on COMException

proposed_comments.body:
**Severity:** `medium`

The Mouse Without Borders App build fails StyleCop `SA1518` because both `InputSimulation.cs` and `InitAndCleanup.cs` have an extra blank line after the final closing brace. Please remove only the surplus final blank line in each file, leaving the normal single newline after the brace; the resulting App build then passes without changing runtime code.

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream App build reports SA1518 in both changed files; removing only each surplus EOF CRLF line was applied literally and the focused App build exited 0.
Pinned startup/runtime catch filters omit UnauthorizedAccessException; HRESULT mapping and filter behavior reproduced in a focused .NET harness, and the synchronous startup escape is source-traced

proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: Coordinated expected-exception handling is required across both runtime branches and the startup probe; a standalone catch edit leaves another escape path
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep access-denied injection failures on the fallback path
**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/MouseWithoutBorders/App/Class/InputSimulation.cs:SendInputEx`, `src/modules/MouseWithoutBorders/App/Core/InitAndCleanup.cs:Init`, and the startup call in `src/modules/MouseWithoutBorders/App/Class/Program.cs:Main`.

**Problem:** Both mouse-injection branches catch only `COMException`; the startup probe likewise admits only `EntryPointNotFoundException` or `COMException`. An injection refusal reported as `E_ACCESSDENIED` can project as `UnauthorizedAccessException`, which is not a `COMException`, so it skips the new SendInput fallback.

**Why it matters:** During startup, `MoveMouseRelative` invokes its callback synchronously through `Common.DoSomethingInTheInputSimulationThread`. This exception can therefore escape `Init` into `Program.Main`'s outer logging catch before `Application.Run`, ending startup rather than retaining the fallback.

**Suggested change:**
1. Include the expected `UnauthorizedAccessException` in both runtime fallback guards, preserving the existing logging and SendInput fallback for the current input.
2. Include it in the startup guard as well so a denied probe disables the unavailable injector and initialization continues.
3. Keep handling restricted to expected injection failures; do not swallow arbitrary exceptions or change the global retry policy as part of this fix.

**Verification:** Check that a denied startup probe still reaches the UI loop and a denied runtime injection falls back for the current input in both pointer-width branches; retain the successful-injection path. The exception mapping and filters were checked with a focused harness; actual injector refusal and interactive remote control have not been run here.
